name: session-bridge
description: Exposes a local HTTP endpoint that sends a prompt to a live Claude Code session, chosen by the directory it runs in.

port.title: Hub port
port.description: The port the local HTTP hub listens on (127.0.0.1).

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this session starts an HTTP bridge at all.

timeoutMs.title: Answer timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long a request waits for the session's answer.
